_comment: Las Vegas market signals, channel fee schedules, and scoring parameters. All figures carry a source or an 'assumption' flag.

vegas_market.amazon_footprint: LAS2/LAS6/LAS7 fulfillment centers (North Las Vegas) + SNV1 same-day facility handling ~600K packages/day
vegas_market.interpretation: Amazon-stocked commodity SKUs are extremely well served (same-day). The under-service gap is specifically in TREND products whose dominant offers dropship from China (8-22 days) — plus deadline-driven purchases (events, parties, festivals, forgotten travel items) where same-day availability wins the sale outright.

scoring.notes: underservice = midpoint(dominant offer delivery) minus 2-day Prime baseline, scaled so an 18+ day gap = 100. margin benchmark 70% per 2026 dropship gross-margin data.

shopify_common.notes: Basic plan $39/mo (2.9% + 30c online with Shopify Payments); apps_monthly is a typical review/email/upsell stack (assumption). International cards +1% not modeled.

vegas_3pl.notes: Vegas 3PLs quote privately; these are industry-typical planning rates (pick/pack $2.50-5.00, storage ~$25/pallet/mo, zone 1-2 ground/local courier postage). Verify with Your Logistics, Black Mountain, Red Stag LV, ShipNetwork LV.

amazon_fba.notes: 2026 schedule: referral fees unchanged (8-15% by category); fulfillment fees up ~$0.25 (small standard $10-50) effective 2026-01-15; 3.5% fuel/logistics surcharge on fulfillment fees from 2026-04-17. Tier values are representative mid-weight points from published 2026 tables ($3.11 small standard 2oz to $6.97+ large standard 3lb) — exact fee depends on precise dims/weight.
